research_question: On the released synthetic European power-market memory-stress suite from Experiment 001, does GPT-5.6 Luna at max reasoning reproduce the retained-state advantage over a stateless rolling history, and how do its quality, token use, latency, and estimated cost compare descriptively with the published GPT-5.6 Sol max run?

artifacts.pre_run_disclosure: The exact suite and evaluator labels were released after Experiment 001. Labels remain excluded from model inputs, but Experiment 002 is a released-suite replication rather than a new hidden-set evaluation.
artifacts.post_run_disclosure: Publish the complete Luna run records, comparison tables, failures, and claim boundaries without selectively omitting conditions.

run_matrix.temperature: not sent; unsupported for this model configuration

compatibility_probe.set: public development episode regime-dependent-signal; excluded from all Experiment 002 analyses
compatibility_probe.result: The live Responses API accepted max reasoning and completed the deterministic tool loop with an exact-success memo.

analysis.repeat_handling: Average paired repeat-level values within episode before inference.
analysis.hypothesis_test: two-sided exact episode-level sign-flip test when at most 20 nonzero episode deltas

cross_model_analysis.status: paired descriptive comparison only; no confirmatory cross-model p-value is preregistered because Sol and Luna were executed in separate time blocks on a released suite

budget.rule: Before each paid job, stop if recorded estimated spend plus the next-run reserve would exceed the cap. An incomplete matrix is not claim-supporting.

interpretation_limits: This reuses a released synthetic suite and is not a second hidden-set experiment.
The eight cases deliberately stress evidence loss beyond a three-action rolling window; they are not representative of all agentic workflows.
The 1,000-token threshold is carried unchanged from Experiment 001 to isolate the model change and remains an aggressive forced-compaction stress test.
Within-Luna retention is the primary replication contrast. Sol-versus-Luna results are paired descriptive comparisons from separate execution periods.
The model IDs are aliases rather than dated snapshots; every returned response model ID is retained.
The cases are synthetic power-market investigations, not live trading research or evidence of market alpha.
